periods.label: 雷切的预告

status.current: scheduled as Shizuku Kurogane's next opponent; subject of campus debate against Ikki

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Students begin debating whether Ikki could rival her after he beats Kuraudo.

periods.summary: Toka does not appear directly in vol-02, but her status drives the epilogue. After Ikki defeats Kuraudo, students begin comparing the Worst One with Hagun's strongest student, Raikiri. At the same time Shizuku receives notice that her next selection opponent is Toka Todo, causing Shizuku to seek harder training and anticipate a serious fight.

key_events.summary: Named as Shizuku's next opponent and as Hagun's strongest student.

periods.time: Final selection battles and representative ceremony
periods.label: 雷切的巅峰与败北
periods.affiliation: Hagun Academy student council; Wakaba Home orphanage

status.current: loses the final selection battle to Ikki but entrusts Hagun's flag and expectations to him

relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Defeats Shizuku in a B-rank duel while recognizing her courage.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Respects him as a knight; loses to his Ittou Rasetsu and later personally hands him the school flag.
relationships.utakata-misogi: Childhood friend from Wakaba Home and student council vice-president; he supports her anxieties.
relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Student council treasurer and old friend from Wakaba Home circles.
relationships.torajiro-nango: Teacher whose martial arts, Nuk足 and original sword skills shaped Toka's style.

periods.summary: Toka dominates vol-03 as Hagun's strongest student. She defeats Shizuku by combining lightning magic, martial footwork, Reverse Sight and the unavoidable Raikiri. Off the battlefield she is a caring, clumsy, motherly student council president who knows many students by name, comes from Wakaba Home, cooks for others, and carries the hopes of orphanage children. She rescues Ikki and Stella from remote stone puppets during the Okutama investigation, then is forced by the Ethics Committee's scheme into becoming Ikki's final opponent. She initially hopes he will withdraw for his health, but when he appears she rejoices as a knight and meets his challenge head-on. Her best Raikiri is shattered by Ikki's Ittou Rasetsu. In the epilogue she accepts defeat with pride, resolves to grow stronger, and hands Ikki the Hagun flag during the representative ceremony.

key_events.summary: Defeats Shizuku without taking a decisive wound.
Identifies the wire-puppet hub and destroys the attackers with Raikiri.
Warns Shizuku that she may have to fight Ikki at full force.
Accepts Ikki's direct challenge to Raikiri and loses.
Hands the school flag to Ikki and asks him to carry the defeated fighters' wishes.

periods.label: 雷切的指导与断后
periods.occupation: student knight; student council president; training coach

status.current: unconscious after defending Hagun against Akatsuki
status.representative_status: not a Seven Stars representative this year but still one of Hagun's strongest fighters

personality.summary: Calm, dutiful and tactically mature; prioritizes preserving Hagun representatives over personal pride.

relationships.stella-vermillion: Camp sparring partner; teaches her that top fighters weaponize their own weaknesses, then later knocks her out to evacuate her from Ouma.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: Cannot meaningfully injure him even with Raikiri and Takemikazuchi; is defeated by Kusanagi.
relationships.student-council: Leads them in a delaying action after evacuating Hagun's representatives.

periods.summary: Toka serves as a volunteer coach at the Yamagata camp and defeats Stella by baiting her counter to Raikiri, demonstrating the tactical level needed for national top fighters. During Akatsuki's assault she makes the key decision that Hagun's representatives must survive to keep Akatsuki from replacing Hagun at Seven Stars. She rescues Stella from Ouma's Kusanagi, stuns her, orders the Hagure sisters to flee with her, and remains with the student council to delay Akatsuki. Her Raikiri and unfinished Takemikazuchi fail to truly wound Ouma, and she is defeated by his Kusanagi.

key_events.summary: Defeats Stella and explains national-level baiting tactics.
Saves Stella from Ouma, forces her evacuation, and stays behind.
Falls after failing to pierce Ouma's defense.

periods.time: Seven Stars opening day, while hospitalized at Hagun
periods.label: 雷切苏醒观战

status.current: wakes from the exhaustion caused by Ouma's Fantasy Form attack and watches Ikki's match from hospital

relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Student council ally at her bedside when she awakens.
relationships.utakata-misogi: Student council vice president still asleep in the neighboring bed.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Former selection opponent; she analyzes his odds against Moroboshi and cheers for him.
relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Former Seven Stars opponent who defeated her by denying Raikiri range.

periods.summary: Toka wakes in Hagun's hospital after the Akatsuki attack and learns that the student council only suffered Fantasy Form damage. She watches the Seven Stars broadcast with Kanata, worries at first about Stella's delayed match, then analyzes Ikki's first-round fight with Moroboshi. Because she has fought both men, she judges that Moroboshi is only slightly favored and explains Moroboshi's spear weaknesses and hidden strengths.

key_events.summary: Wakes in hospital and learns Stella's match was postponed.
Analyzes Ikki versus Moroboshi from the hospital broadcast.

periods.time: While hospitalized after the Akatsuki attack
periods.label: 雷切病房观战

status.current: hospitalized but awake enough to watch the Seven Stars broadcast with Kanata

personality.summary: Gracious and competitive; she is grateful for Stella's kindness, analyzes the tournament calmly, yet still regrets not fighting as a contestant herself.
fears: Stella being cornered by Akatsuki's matchup

relationships.stella-vermillion: Junior whose four-on-one challenge Touka understands as revenge for injured Hagun students.
relationships.utakata-misogi: Fellow student council member who wakes in the next bed and warns about Amane.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Former opponent; she accepts her loss but would like to challenge him again after the tournament.
relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Hospital roommate/visitor who explains Tatara's reflection ability from experience.

periods.summary: Touka watches Stella's unprecedented four-on-one B-block match from her hospital room with Kanata. She understands Stella's motive: preventing Akatsuki representatives from avoiding punishment for the Hagun attack. Kanata's report lets Touka identify Tatara as a reflection mage and worry about the matchup. After Stella wins, Touka evaluates the tournament's remaining contenders, naming Stella, Ouma, Kiriko, Shizuku, Kaga and Ikki among possible champions, and admits she wishes she could have fought as a contestant. When Utakata wakes, Touka begins to explain the current situation, leading to his urgent warning about Amane.

key_events.summary: Learns from Kanata that Tatara's Complete Reflection makes her a terrible opponent for Stella.
Helps orient Utakata after he wakes, prompting his warning about Amane.

periods.label: 怕鬼但尽责的学生会长

personality.summary: Dutiful and responsible even when frightened; tries to uphold student council obligations.

relationships.stella-vermillion: Fellow ghost-fearing search partner; they argue over who enters the bathroom first.
relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Student council colleague who secretly scares her during the test of courage.
relationships.utakata-misogi: Vice president who begins the ghost-story gathering.

periods.summary: Toka appears in the ghost-story side episode after the selection battles. Although terrified by Utakata's and Kanata's stories, she insists on joining the search because she is the student council president. Paired with Stella, she uses electromagnetic sensing to confirm a bathroom has no human inside, but both are tricked by Kanata's projected ghost and flee screaming. She also helps explain the legal problem of dangerous special individual animals after the monkey is captured.

key_events.summary: Participates in the test-of-courage search and is scared by Kanata's projection.

periods.time: Seven Stars semifinals and delayed final announcement
periods.label: 见证后辈跨越自己的雷切

status.current: fully recovered from prior coma and supporting Ikki and Stella from the stands

personality.summary: Warm, perceptive, and honest about the awe she feels watching Stella and Ikki surpass earlier limits.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Former opponent; she cheers him on and senses his grave resolve before the Amane match.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Junior she admires; she recognizes Stella's growth and later cheers both finalists.
relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Friend who attends the semifinals with her.

periods.summary: Toka arrives in Osaka with Kanata and Nene to watch the semifinals, fully recovered after having slept for a long time. She praises Stella's expression and notices how far Stella has advanced, later admitting that current Stella has grown beyond her own level. Before Ikki's semifinal she senses a heavy resolve in him similar to the day he arrived half-dead for their selection match. During Amane's heart-stop attack, Toka's sensitivity to body electrical signals lets her recognize Ikki's heart stopping before most spectators understand the danger. She also appears among the supporters waiting for the delayed Ikki-Stella final.

key_events.summary: Watches Stella's growth and Ouma's abnormal defenses.
Recognizes Ikki's heart stoppage and supports his advance.
Cheers both Ikki and Stella after the final is rescheduled.

periods.time: Final day of the Seven Stars Festival
periods.label: 协助一辉调整的雷切

status.current: helps Ikki prepare, observes the final, and has her entrusted school flag raised by him

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Former selection-final opponent; responds to his request and pressures him seriously in a tuning match.
relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Friend who covers for her delayed arrival to the student council group.
relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Peer-level helper in Ikki's preparation gauntlet.

periods.summary: Toka delays joining the student council because Ikki asks her to help him prepare. In the training ring she exploits the weakness of Ikki's Edelweiss-derived movement by alternating Raio shots, then forces him into close-range swordplay with her Denkou-accelerated counters and threatens Raikiri. Ikki defeats her by using battlefield debris to jam Narukami's sheath, and Toka recognizes his broader battlefield intelligence. At the award ceremony, the Hagun flag she entrusted to Ikki is handed to him so he can raise it from the champion podium.

key_events.summary: Spars with Ikki and forces him to improvise against Denkou and Raikiri.
Her entrusted Hagun flag becomes the symbol Ikki raises as champion.

periods.time: Ikki's victory party at Ittousei after Seven Stars

status.current: plans to train over summer and enter Japan's National League after graduation
status.condition: frustrated she never fought Moroboshi but motivated by Ikki and Stella's level

relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Friendly rival; they discuss the anti-Hahakiboshi technique and promise to meet in higher leagues.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Junior whose victory pushes her to re-evaluate her own immaturity.
relationships.nango-torajiro: Teacher she plans to train under during summer.

periods.summary: Toka attends Ikki's victory party and discusses with Moroboshi the match they never had. She confirms that her electromagnetic sword technique Raikou was refined partly to counter Moroboshi's Hahakiboshi, and the two jokingly argue over who would have won. After seeing Ikki and Stella's final, Toka realizes she is still immature and plans to spend summer retraining under her master before entering the domestic league and aiming for the A-League.

key_events.summary: Discusses future professional paths with Moroboshi.

periods.time: After Japan's special conscription ends and during her return to Fukuoka
periods.label: 守护若叶之家并遭遇大炎
periods.affiliation: Hagun Academy; Wakaba House; Todo family

status.current: discovers that the kind old man she helped is Harima Tendo, the escaped Great Flame
status.condition: emotionally shaken after trying to protect her foster family and then seeing Tendo's true ideology

relationships.utakata-misogi: Childhood friend from Wakaba House who returns with her and challenges her thinking.
relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Childhood friend and benefactor's daughter who supports Wakaba House and mediates social conflict.
relationships.toshiko-nishikata: Foster mother and Wakaba House director whose exhaustion makes Toka determined to protect the home.
relationships.harima-tendo: Initially a starving blind elder whom Toka respects; revealed as Great Flame after he reacts to her chamomile story.
relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Rival she still regrets not rematching before he leaves for China.
relationships.kuraudo-kurashiki: Potential opponent whom she believes she can beat due to matchup advantages.

periods.summary: Toka finishes special conscription, trains at the League branch, observes Kuraudo's spar with Moroboshi, and then returns to Fukuoka with Uta and Kanata. At Wakaba House she learns that local parents led by Mrs. Ito have spread rumors, encouraged bullying, locked the trash area and harassed the orphanage. Toka initially wants to solve the problem by staying home and using her standing and power, but the blind elder Harima Tendo advises mutual understanding through volunteer work and greetings. His approach helps the children reconcile with their bullies, teaching Toka that she had been too quick to rely on force. At her parents' grave she shares the chamomile flower-language memory that shaped her ideal of becoming a supportive adult. The story triggers Harima's fanatic revelation as Great Flame; Toka instantly attacks with Raikiri, but he blocks it with Ama no Murakumo.

key_events.summary: Discusses Ikki's heroic rise and plans to return to Kyushu.
Analyzes the matchup and Kuraudo's growth.
Confronts neighborhood harassment and learns a nonviolent path to reconciliation.
Realizes Harima is a dangerous fanatic and tries to subdue him with Raikiri.

periods.time: Kyushu disaster and simultaneous Tokyo defense crisis
periods.label: 以众人之力斩断大炎
periods.affiliation: Hagun Academy; Wakaba House; International Mage-Knight League Japan branch

status.current: defeats Harima Tendo's post-death storm by channeling Kyushu's restored power grid into Raikiri
status.condition: emotionally shaken by Tendo's death-imprint, then stabilized by Nishikata and Wakaba House; physically exhausted after the decisive strike

relationships.harima-tendo: Tendo targets her as a candidate for his so-called grace, breaks her confidence, then becomes the enemy she defeats by rejecting his premise.
relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Friend who warns and supports her during the evacuation and crisis response.
relationships.utakata-misogi: Close friend from Hagun; injured while saving her from the landslide.
relationships.nishikata-hisako: Wakaba House director and maternal figure who teaches Toka that she may stop forcing herself to be a hero.
relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Ally who buys time against Tendo and entrusts her with the third-arrow role.
relationships.kuraudo-kurashiki: Ally whose frontal assault helps create the opening for Toka's final strike.

periods.summary: Toka initially accompanies Harima Tendo to a graveyard and discovers he is the terrorist called Daien. Tendo overwhelms her with disaster-class magic, forces her to witness Fukuoka being destroyed, and later imprints on her the certainty of her own death if she faces him again. Toka first tries to force an Awakening through fear, but repeated mental deaths break her. Nishikata and the children of Wakaba House remind her that strength can mean accepting help rather than surpassing fate alone. Toka then proposes using Kyushu's restored electrical grid as a collective weapon: civilians repair lines and operate plants, knights protect them, and she receives the power at Central Substation. With that entrusted force she launches herself by electromagnetic repulsion, cuts through Tendo's God Breath and cloud-body with Raikiri, and proves that joined human effort can surpass his false grace.

key_events.summary: Fights Tendo at the graveyard, fails to touch his spirit body, and sees Fukuoka devastated by disaster magic.
Awakens in Miyazaki and learns about Desperado, Brute Soul, Excessive Awakening, and Tendo's history.
Tendo's gravity shows her a repeated crucifixion-death vision and she nearly collapses under the obligation to awaken.
Asks civilians, engineers, knights, and shelters to fight together by restoring the Kyushu grid.
Uses Kyushu's combined electricity to destroy Tendo's remnant and clear the storm.

periods.label: 雷切参与红莲皇女救援
periods.affiliation: Hagun Academy student council; Union Japan rescue team

status.volume_role: high-speed assault member and rear-guard against Abrahams

personality.summary: Touka stays composed even amid family conflict and urgency. She accepts the rescue order, applies battlefield judgment, and uses her speed and lightning to neutralize threats far above ordinary student level.
values: not wasting time on internal conflict
flaws: can only watch as Kurogane family tensions erupt before Itsuki clarifies his order

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Junior and rescue leader by emotional stake; she supports his mission and later protects the route.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: Fights beside him against Abraham clones; recognizes their shared natural-interference ability to draw external energy.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Protects him from Abraham's surprise attack and fights with him as rear support.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Friend/comrade to be rescued; later a possessed threat whose blast leaves Touka unconscious.
relationships.shinguji-kurono: Her victory over PSYON is referenced; Touka compares Abraham strength to what Kurono overcame.

periods.summary: Touka is present when Ikki wakes and learns Stella has been abducted. Itsuki orders her onto the rescue team, trusting her near-A-class capability after the Kyushu incident. At the Nikko site she slices through fortified mercenaries with Raioh, disassembles a Large EDY by racing across its joints with Shippu Jinrai, and uses Reverse Sight to check an apparently empty fourth-floor battlefield. Abraham clones ambush the team; Touka protects Alice but is injured, then draws power from the laboratory wiring to become a lightning-like combatant and cut down one Abraham with Raikiri. Along with Ouma and Alice she holds the Abrahams while Ikki and Shizuku continue downward. She later survives possessed Stella's destructive blast thanks in part to Ouma's protection.

key_events.summary: Is assigned by Itsuki as one of the official rescue members.
Destroys mercenary fortifications and a Large EDY with lightning speed.
Cuts down an Abraham and joins the rear-guard fight on the fourth floor.
